subject: 243 Mystic Avenue Planned Development District Rezoning
overview: The Board recommended a zoning amendment to facilitate a life sciences development at 243 Mystic Avenue and discussed the city's timeline for MBTA Communities zoning compliance. Members also received updates on recent City Council actions regarding energy codes and Medford Square financing.

items.title: 3850 Mississippi Valley Parkway Drive-Thru
items.summary: Tabled the special permit application for a Bank of America drive-thru until October 4 at the applicant's request.

items.title: 243 Mystic Avenue PDD Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Recommended that the City Council adopt a zoning map amendment changing 243 Mystic Avenue from Commercial 2 to a Planned Development District (PDD) for a proposed life sciences facility. Legal counsel and staff explained that the overlay district would allow greater density and life sciences use by right, though the specific project will require subsequent site plan review and a special permit.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Procedural Matters
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the August 2, 2023 meeting and affirmed procedural rules requiring members to be recognized by the chair before speaking.

items.title: Staff Updates and MBTA Communities Discussion
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the city's progress toward MBTA Communities (Section 3A) compliance and the City Council's preliminary approval of the extended stretch energy code and Medford Square financing. The Board discussed ongoing parking lease disputes delaying the Bank of America project and considered rescheduling the next meeting to avoid a conflict with a mayoral debate.
